items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Which Mike Lala are you talking about? The one they call Black Mike?

ctx.x: Well, he was good. He was good. He was an all-around man. Then you had Luba Prima. I had Luba Prima, Leon Prima. He was a legitimate. I had Luba Prima, Leon Prima, my little cousin Mike Lala. I had Tony this. I had more trumpet players.
Which Mike Lala are you talking about? The one they call Black Mike? Black Mike's my son. White Mike is your son? Yeah. My son, yeah. He plays a lot of trumpet.

And I had them all. I never touched a trumpet for two weeks. They always come up. Little Luba Prima, Leon Prima, a little Femulara. He was working in the theater. He'd come up there and play after. All I had, they made a carnet player line up by the minimums up there.
